known_prior_evidence.V11_1: 70% V10.2 anchor nearly retained control precision and improved recent precision/drawdown but remained momentum-dominated.
known_prior_evidence.V11_2_60_40_hard_gate: Retained ~97.8% of 6m precision and selected earlier/lower-priced-in stories, but recent 6m precision and lift weakened.
known_prior_evidence.V11_2_65_35_effective: Earlier/lower-priced-in selections improved, but 6m precision/lift deteriorated substantially.

objective: Find transformation stories before they become obvious, even when the 2x realization takes longer than six months.
core_change: Stop judging transformation discovery primarily on a six-month 2x label.
Train independent transformation models for 6m, 12m and 24m 2x outcomes.
Weight transformation horizon probability 20% y6, 35% y12, 45% y24.
Transformation evidence receives 70% of final ranking; V10.2 receives 30% as confirmation.
Pure V10.2 momentum names cannot enter without a transformation gate.
Track early-stage, priced-in penalty and catalyst prevalence alongside return outcomes.
Keep a separate radar for very early transformation candidates with weak technical confirmation.
methodology_note: This is a new objective definition after observing that higher transformation weights improve early-stage characteristics but can look weak under a six-month-only target. Prospective shadow validation remains mandatory.
